card.name: Spacing before dose-interval numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small word just before a dose number or interval, such as after 'every' or 'dose of' in acetaminophen and codeine labels. It also fires on 'and' or 'of' inside the heading 'Ultra-Rapid Metabolism of Codeine and Other Risk Factors'.

modes.label: Before dose number
modes.description: A blank space or 'q' right before a number giving a dose amount or hour interval.
